name: vllm_convert_vertical_slash_indexes
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench test_convert_vertical_slash_indexes.py. Convert vertical/slash sparse attention indexes: q_seqlens/kv_seqlens (B,) int32, vertical_indexes/slash_indexes (B,q_len,q_len) int32, context_size/block_size_M/block_size_N scalars. Reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.convert_vertical_slash_indexes and returns tuple (block_count, column_index). causal=True hardcoded. Shapes interdependent → gen_inputs. Test compares tuple elements with torch.equal. Requires vLLM at eval time.
